'''2012 European Championship Kevin Jaap LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Jaap]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Infiltration / Unlikely Allies|VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
